description.value: Kaede Sushi is a Japanese restaurant on Esplanade Avenue in Ladysmith serving an extensive menu of sushi rolls, nigiri, sashimi, and cooked dinner dishes with a distinctly house-crafted style. The menu spans traditional preparations alongside inventive specials and a full dessert menu of Japanese-inspired sweets including homemade mochi and chiffon cake. Takeout is available by phone, making it a practical stop for cyclists passing through town.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for kaedesushi.com was successfully fetched and confirms an active Japanese restaurant at 734 Esplanade Avenue in Ladysmith offering dine-in and takeout. The phrase 'Please call us for Take-out and Reservations' on the home page confirms takeout availability, and the dinner menu includes multiple vegetarian options (Veggie Roll, Yam Roll, Agedashi Tofu, Tofu Steak, Tofu Dengaku, Tofu Salad, Veggie Tempura, Veggie Kushiage, Edamame). No evidence of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any cycling infrastructure appears on the website or in OSM tags.
